_note: Real ONC rockfish frames from the Interactive Map, the ones the team marked small, partial or blurry, with the rockfish model's result as returned (model). They start with no prior votes: nobody else has reviewed them yet.

clips.tip: Rockfish have a spiny dorsal fin along most of the back and a large head with big eyes. Lingcod and greenlings are longer and slimmer. If the fish is too small or blurry to tell, choose "Can't tell".
